propositions: An s3:// or s3+zip:// ticket-store remote without a git-remote-s3 helper (or with version <0.3.2) causes silent store corruption via duplicate bundle files due to missing IfNoneMatch per-ref locking.
Store operations (init and push) must fail closed with an actionable error message naming the required pip install command when an S3-scheme remote is configured but the helper is missing or too old.
The S3 helper preflight guard must raise OptionalDependencyError unconditionally, independent of push_tickets_branch's best-effort strict flag, to prevent corrupting unlocked S3 pushes.

The preflight detection reuses the existing remote URL resolution (_git remote get-url) without introducing new resolution seams, and applies only to s3:// and s3+zip:// schemes while treating other schemes and unresolvable remotes as no-ops.
